units: <cite ref="Eruvin 53b:10">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (in enigmatic speech) <he>ע׳ נקפת וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N01233"><he>נְקַף</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:10">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>יעדי כתר … ותיקפי ע׳ בכד וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) shall the crown (stopper) of another (jug) be removed, that the ladle may float like a ship &c.?
